title: 2021-22 Panini Donruss #104 Keldon Johnson San Antonio Spurs Basketball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021-22 Panini Donruss trading card featuring NBA player Keldon Johnson from the San Antonio Spurs. It is a single card made of 20 Pt. card stock in English language. The card is part of the base set and is an original licensed reprint by Panini. This modern basketball trading card is a perfect addition for fans of the National Basketball Association looking to collect and showcase their favorite player.
